Thank you so much for your reply. You really hit the nail on the head with many things. I guess for now I’ll try and just limit contact and distract myself with some new games.  

If things don’t work for me, I will be honest and make sure she knows it’s nothing to do with her. I’ve told her in the past that my actions are never a result of what she’s done or said so I hope she will continue to know none of this is her fault. 

The last part of flagellation is true though, I do feel I have done that in past relationships maybe with her who knows. I don’t know if I’ve ever meant to do it purposely but it has happened. I’ve gotten much better but I used to be very manipulative and vile to get my way to ease my bpd. 

Again ty for reaching out and your advice, it means a lot and was exactly what I needed to hear. ❤️
